//: trips.outbox → trip.events, channel trips_outbox (db/migrations/0505). Set in
TripStateApplication so the defaults are right without configuration; this section exists
to override them, not to supply them. Unlike registry.events and provisioning.events the
trip-state-svc only validates tokens — iam-svc mints them (C026). Issuer must match the
one iam-svc signs with or every request is a 401.
US-5.3 fixes the idle timeout at 30 minutes and US-5.4 the arrival fence at 100 m; US-5.10
fixes the restart grace at 5. MovementThresholdM, MovementSpeedMps and OfflineGrace are
this service's numbers — no spec pins them; see Configuration/TripStateOptions.cs.
